debug.description: Enable debug mode to output logs to stderr.

user.description: The user policyd-rate-limit will use to drop privileges.

group.description: The group policyd-rate-limit will use to drop privileges.

pidfile.description: Path where the program will try to write its pid to.

sqlite_database.description: Path to the SQLite3 database file.

backend.description: Which data backend to use. 0 for sqlite3, 1 for mysql, 2 for postgresql.

socket_path.description: The socket to bind to. Path to a unix socket or [ip, port] list.

socket_permission.description: Permissions on the unix socket (if unix socket used).

limits_0_count.description: First limit: number of emails allowed in the time window.

limits_0_seconds.description: First limit: time window in seconds.

limits_1_count.description: Second limit: number of emails allowed in the time window.

limits_1_seconds.description: Second limit: time window in seconds.

sql_limits_by_id.description: SQL query to fetch custom limits by user ID. Empty string disables it.

limit_by_sender.description: Apply limits by sender addresses if no SASL username is found.

limit_by_ip.description: Apply limits by IP addresses if no SASL username or sender is found.

success_action.description: Action postfix should take if no limits are reached.

fail_action.default: defer_if_permit Rate limit reach, retry later
fail_action.description: Action postfix should take if a limit is reached.

db_error_action.description: Action postfix should take if unable to connect to the database backend.

report.description: Send a report to report_to about users reaching limits.

report_from.description: From address for report emails. Must be defined if report is True.

report_to.description: Address to send report emails to. Can be single address or list.

report_limits_0.description: List of number of seconds from the limits list for which you want to be reported.

report_only_if_needed.description: Only send a report if some users have reached a reported limit.

smtp_host.description: Host of the SMTP server to use to send emails.

smtp_starttls.description: Whether to use STARTTLS for SMTP connections.

delay_to_close.description: Time in seconds before an unused socket gets closed.

count_mode.description: How sent mails are counted. 0 for individual RCPT TO (deprecated), 1 for DATA stage.
